nonProvenRows.item: `/#race` opens a full-screen playable kart race.
nonProvenRows.proofNeeded: Desktop keyboard manual run confirms full-screen playable race, start-to-finish route, pause/resume, and exit path.

nonProvenRows.item: The player can accelerate, brake, steer, hop, drift, release mini-turbo, use items, hit boost pads, collide, recover, and finish a race.
nonProvenRows.proofNeeded: Manual desktop keyboard and mobile touch runs prove all core actions are usable by a human player.

nonProvenRows.item: Drift is the central satisfying mechanic.
nonProvenRows.proofNeeded: Manual QA gives drift score `4+` with notes for start, hold, charge, side slip, sparks/audio, and release boost.

nonProvenRows.item: The chase camera frames the kart and road like an arcade kart racer.
nonProvenRows.proofNeeded: Speed/drift/turn screenshots are reviewed against the owner-approved target and manual camera score is `4+`.

nonProvenRows.item: Comeback City GP has dense district landmarks, readable turns, barriers, boost pads, item boxes, hazards, and finish-line presentation.
nonProvenRows.proofNeeded: Product/design review confirms landmarks/density/route readability against approved target; manual first-lap run confirms route can be followed without minimap.

nonProvenRows.item: HUD supports race decisions without blocking the view.
nonProvenRows.proofNeeded: Manual/design review confirms HUD readability and no route/apex/item/rival obstruction on desktop and mobile.

nonProvenRows.item: Desktop keyboard and mobile touch both work.
nonProvenRows.proofNeeded: Manual desktop keyboard run and mobile touch run are recorded with results and scores.
FPS must meet agreed floor; screenshots and telemetry must still pass after performance and visual changes.

nonProvenRows.item: Manual QA rubric scores are all 4 or higher.
nonProvenRows.proofNeeded: Completed owner QA desktop and mobile artifacts with every category scored `4+`.

nonProvenRows.item: A fresh user watching 10 seconds of gameplay describes it as a kart race, not a menu or tech demo.
nonProvenRows.proofNeeded: Owner clip answer recorded in manual QA runbook or dated review artifact, or explicit owner-scoped exception recorded.

failingRows.requiredCheck: A silent 10 second clip reads as a kart race, not a menu or tech demo.
Keyboard acceleration, braking, steering, drift, and item use feel responsive in the first lap.
Hop, side slip, tier feedback, and release boost are easy to start and understand.
Player can see road, apexes, hazards, item boxes, rivals, and exits without fighting the camera.
First lap can be followed without minimap or prior route knowledge.
City density, landmarks, surface detail, VFX, and finish/start presentation feel intentional.
Rivals, items, boosts, hazards, and position changes are noticeable during normal play.
Position, lap, timer, item, drift/boost state, and controls are readable without blocking the route.
Desktop and mobile stay smooth enough for manual play, with telemetry attached.
Touch controls can complete a race without hiding kart, route, apex, or item boxes.
